## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 27 июн. 2026 г. - 26 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _CreativeCatnip_, 26 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I’ve written at least five reviews and each time I come back to update they’re gone. HR grossly inaccurate. Latest update lost all my data and took 45 minutes to sync phone again. I’ve learned to rely or expect much from the watch. It’s glitchy and hit or miss if it will work."
            2. _Teessiderang_, 30 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "This App keeps force closing on me. It is very slow to update doesn't do it in real time like Zepp does. If it doesn't improve when it comes to buying another Mi band I think I'll look for another Brand instead Update: its still lousy and at the moment can't get the App to show me anything. Its virtually useless!!! Updated 02.06.26 have tried to factory reset device, delete and reinstalled the App and it now refuses to connect and will only show the QR code. Utterly useless. Xiaomi you have lost a loyal customer Updated 29.08.26 This App will not let report to Feedback. This is the only way I can vent my frustrations. It will not sync correctly to my phone. The data on the device is completely different to the data presented on the app. How can you tell how you are progressing if the data on the phone is incorrect? Do Xiaomi even check this feedback on the App Store? I very much doubt it as they have never replied to me."
            3. _Amir hosein Abedian_, 28 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Makes my whole phone slow! Also cannot sync with my mi band 9! I tried everything! Cannot maintain connection with mi band 9 either during a workout."
<!--/ir-theme-->
